name: n8n
author: n8n-io
description: Self-hosted Zapier: visual workflows wiring schedules, webhooks and APIs to everything else here — ollama, ntfy, Seafile, any loopback service. Host-network container on 127.0.0.1:5678 with SQLite storage. Often stopped on purpose; scheduled workflows do not run while it is down. Its .env holds the encryption key that every saved credential is encrypted with, so back that up with the data.
